title: Mathematical and experimental validation of the bifocusing method tailored for bistatic measurement
summary: In this paper, we design a bifocusing-based imaging strategy for the rapid identification of small penetrable dielectric inhomogeneities within a two-dimensional bistatic measurement setup. To address the applicability and limitation, we carefully explore the mathematical structure of the indicator function by establishing a relationship involving the infinite series of Bessel functions, the material characteristics, and the bistatic angle.
